# Shiva — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Shiva associated with?", "Hindu, The destroyer/transformer"),
    ("What is notable about Shiva?", "Trident, drum"),

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
